北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天，体感 9℃ 略凉，注意保暖，多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy day, feels like 9℃. Keep warm and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，能见度低。出行注意安全，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Misty in Cixi, low visibility. Drive safely and avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温适中。注意湿度，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Shanghai, temperature's mild. Mind the humidity, keep spirits high!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州大雾，体感湿热。出门注意安全，小心湿滑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog in Guangzhou, feels warm and humid. Be careful outdoors, watch for slippery surfaces!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，湿度高。记得带伞，保持室内通风！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Shenzhen, high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella, keep rooms ventilated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，气温宜人。出门记得带把伞，有备无患哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Hangzhou, pleasant temperature. Bring an umbrella, just in case!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 19℃。穿衣适度，注意温度变化。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Nanjing, feels like 19℃. Dress appropriately, mind temperature changes.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温舒适。保持好心情，享受悠闲时光！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Chengdu, comfortable temperature. Stay cheerful and enjoy your day!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾弥漫，注意交通安全。湿度高，注意防潮！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog in Wuhan, mind traffic safety. High humidity, watch for dampness!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 18℃。早晚温差大，别着凉哦！

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
